intro: Zombie War plunges players into a relentless battle for survival against hordes of the undead.
description:
Set in a grim and desolate world overrun by zombies, the game challenges players to fend off wave after wave of increasingly formidable enemies. 
With its top-down view and fast-paced action, Zombie War offers an adrenaline-pumping experience that will keep players on the edge of their seats. 
Armed with an arsenal of weapons and gear, players must fight tooth and nail to stay alive in the face of overwhelming odds.

Fight and thrive in the endless onslaught of zombies. 
Upgrade your gear and weapons and keep up with stronger enemies. 
Your main goal in this grim world is survival.

Upgrade your gear and weapons to progress in the game as the difficulty rises. 
Pick up useful loot and use your special abilities to survive as long as possible.
